narrative_purpose: A decorative atmospheric layer for the chapter - a faint repeating motif of the six-limbed frame dissolving into the dark, setting mood without competing with the text.
subject: An abstract field of faint, repeating ghost-silhouettes of the six-limbed Pandoran body frame, scattered and overlapping at low opacity like specimens drifting in dark water, fading toward the edges into pure void.
scene: Bottomless dark space, the silhouettes suspended and receding, no ground, no horizon.
camera: A drifting, depthless field view with no single focus, motifs at varied scales and softness.
light: Very low bioluminescent glow tracing a few of the silhouettes' frames, most barely visible; deep indigo throughout.
palette: Almost entirely void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, the faintest cyan tracing, no warm accents.
style: Painterly atmospheric wash, hand-painted haze, deliberately low-contrast and unobtrusive.
detail_level: Intentionally soft everywhere - a mood layer, no sharp focal point, motifs dissolving into dark.
composition: An even, edge-darkened field with no dominant subject, safe for text overlay, generous void.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, extremely restrained. A background plate only - must never compete with foreground text or figures.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no arrows, no high-contrast focal subject, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon or anime style
